description: Independently selected diagnostic counts for exact Gaussian regression posteriors under the reversible Gaussian AR sampler, fixed before computing alignment curves.

posterior_provenance.posterior: exact N(mu, C) of the R3 regression model (regression_data.frozen_model)

calibration.features: 512-landmark whitened Nystrom (setup run); centring by the pooled empirical mean

rules.rule1: |rho_m|-|rho_m+1| (pooled, lag-tau eigenvalues) > 5.0 half-split units (max_{j<=m+2} ||rho_j^A|-|rho_j^B||/2) and half-split embedded-span angle <= 10.0 deg
rules.rule2: pooled top-m embedded span at the next longer lag within 10.0 deg
rules.rule3: smallest eligible lag; up to two m with largest gap ratio (ties -> smaller m)
rules.rule4: strict true Hermite gap after the complete selected cluster + embedded rank m (recorded, never replaced)

concrete.time_extension_rule: geometric to at most 4096 only if the evaluated bound predicts an informative window beyond 512 (resolved positive point with g_t < 1 at t = 512)
